annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it presents ONE COIN sales training that promotes a 1,000 EUR investment by citing 2,000 EUR additional income and a 5,000% yearly return, then instructs participants to use these figures in investment pitches. It also encourages broad outreach to recruit project partners and sets short response and payment deadlines, tying urgency to the investment solicitation. Although the speaker cautions against invented claims and promoting the project when uncertain, those caveats coexist with the return claims and direct sales guidance.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The training describes investing money in the OneCoin project, acquiring coins expected to become more expensive, and presenting projected investor income to others. This supports a token-participation and appreciation mechanism; it does not establish realized returns.
